messages.subject: New addition to online distance sampling workshop
parts:
Distance samplers:

You know we have introductory workshop materials (lecture videos, PDFs, exercises, datasets) available online

https://workshops.distancesampling.org/online-course/

In the past couple of months we have added material on automated survey design and performing analysis in R.  Today we announce the first self-assessment quiz, specific to material in the introductory chapter.  There are a number of multiple choice questions you can answer to assess your understanding of the concepts that underpin distance sampling.  More quizzes are in the offing for the new year.

Have a look through the quiz; suggest colleagues new to distance sampling to have a look at the materials.  If you have the ambition to both work through the course and provide thoughts to us about how to structure this and future quizzes, we'd be pleased to hear from you.  Send your comments about quizzes or anything related to the materials to 
distance.onl...@gmail.com
